text: This is a fan-made generator for the Warrior Cats book series by Erin Hunter.
You're welcome to use the characters and sprites generated in this program, as long as you don't claim the sprites as your own creations or sell them for any reason.
<i>(hover over a name to see their contributions!)
Thank you to the beta testers and all those who have helped with development.
Composed by Sharon Hurvitz and Carl-Isaak Krulewitch
In-game music: Ancient Tunnels, Crossing the River, Dawn Patrol, Leafbare, Moonhigh Vigil, Moonstone, Newleaf, The Medicine Cat's Den
Code is licensed under Mozilla Public License Version 2.0

Upstream projects.LifeGen contributors: LifeGen group medicine-teaching, disrupted senior-lecture and muddy apprentice-nest text/constraints/effects adapted from bab3814eee64852125c004dac588fab809a730e9 resources/lang/en/events/relationship_events/group_interactions/medium positive.json and negative.json (MPL-2.0), expanded to local fixed group sizes 3/4/5; exact source directed amounts, age/role limits and local seven-value saves retained. Multi-condition patrol accumulation compared with the same revision scripts/events_module/patrol/patrol_outcome.py; menu-context music selection with scripts/game_structure/audio/music.py. LifeGen thought companion selection and required-subject checks referenced from bab3814eee64852125c004dac588fab809a730e9 scripts/events_module/thoughts/generate_thoughts.py; mentor/apprentice ID checks compared with scripts/events_module/event_filters.py (MPL-2.0). Adapted to local seven-value relationships, existing outside/death rules, dictionary resources and three afterlives; no signed-value filtering or group migration. LifeGen outbreak recipient eligibility referenced from bab3814eee64852125c004dac588fab809a730e9 scripts/events.py handle_outbreaks (MPL-2.0), adapted to local colony membership and kitten-only condition acquisition without importing the probability-based condition rewrite. LifeGen gameplay, Quick Start flow, shared navigation/header and Events pagination/save layouts, Supplies windows and multi-cat selection, Game Settings access, profile den shortcuts, patrol relationship inspection layouts and sprite outline hit regions, moon-phase animation and context-only event participants, released v0.7.7.5 event frequency/constraint weighting, delayed follow-up contracts, condition definitions/lifecycle text, herb-strength effects, herb shelf-life/rarity data, storage/gathering skill perks, chronic-treatment rules, herb-store ratings/status messages and severity-based treatment/medicine-cat eligibility, extended-family newborn relationship reflection/reaction text, unmated co-parenting settings, five breakup types/reactions, ex-mate reconciliation/rejection text, private/public murder knowledge and delayed murder-discovery contracts for ordinary, medicine-cat, deputy-targeting and leader-life events, concealed drowning/wilderness murders and seven hidden-discovery variants with personality-filtered witness reactions and directed relationship logs, Cruel Season mechanics and modernization reference: https://github.com/sedgestripe/clangen Relationship Positive/Negative view filtering also references LifeGen bab3814eee64852125c004dac588fab809a730e9 scripts/screens/RelationshipScreen.py and scripts/cat_relations/relationship.py (MPL-2.0); adapted as a view-only seven-value total with Balanced explicitly distinguished from empty relationships. Existing signed/tier mechanics are not imported. Relationship-screen Family/Romance filters and numeric hover presentation referenced from LifeGen bab3814eee64852125c004dac588fab809a730e9 (scripts/screens/RelationshipScreen.py and scripts/ui/elements/relation_display.py), adapted to seven local relationship values and existing LifeGen dating eligibility. Full-width relationship card layout and per-card focus/log/profile controls adapted from LifeGen bab3814eee64852125c004dac588fab809a730e9, scripts/screens/RelationshipScreen.py; local seven-value bars, dead-cat logs and extended inspection retained. Profile activity grouping referenced from LifeGen bab3814eee64852125c004dac588fab809a730e9, scripts/screens/ProfileScreen.py:1685; adapted to local mediation and existing profile controls. Moonplace flow compared with the same LifeGen revision; local StarClan eligibility, saved visit limits and gathering reliability corrections retain the existing local dialogue and artwork. Voluntary departure choices referenced from LifeGen bab3814eee64852125c004dac588fab809a730e9 scripts/ui/windows/leave_clan.py, adapted to local outside status and return-home rules. Cruel Season Keep/Replace conflict flow adapted from ClanGen 904012b9e9c62ab24a8988ae23d8a516232ff7e2 scripts/ui/windows/cruel_card_conflicts.py (MPL-2.0), preserving local deck validation and conflicts. Fated Paths modifiers and rank/mate restrictions adapted from ClanGen 904012b9e9c62ab24a8988ae23d8a516232ff7e2 society_cards.json, RoleScreen and ClanSettingsScreen; local succession preference also forced to preserve automatic leadership. Existing source Resolute artwork reused unchanged.
Upstream projects.ClanGen contributors: ClanGen Cruel Season card definitions and mechanics adapted for LGMMKE, including Burnout, Plague Ridden and Longer Illnesses medical effects, Mouths to Feed/Underpopulated litter distributions, Clumsy Paws learning curves and Survival of the Fittest feeding restrictions, Weakened Stars/Forsaken leader-life grants and Not Made To Last breakup rules, Crowfood Chaos prey expiry, Anything For The Throne deputy rivalry and Heartless mate restrictions (source revisions in resources/dicts/cruel_season.json); patrol/Gathering relationship work constraints adapted from ClanGen d918224be9b61aec26da68cc77a3f0128b00a00a while retaining local writing and relationship effects; amputation wound definitions, progression and recovery/infection text adapted from ClanGen 9e5f50c2b1cf1bf3594c8dc4e7db5ab764190437 to local condition IDs, medical treatment and existing scar art; modernization reference: https://github.com/ClanGenOfficial/clangen. Pride and Joy deputy ancestry, creation and manual-role restrictions adapted from ClanGen 904012b9e9c62ab24a8988ae23d8a516232ff7e2 society_cards.json, perform_ceremony.py and RoleScreen; biological/adoptive children and local automatic succession retained. Prideful parent-rank/mate eligibility adapted from the same ClanGen revision, scripts/events_module/pregnancy/check_parents.py and create_kits.py; local pregnancy/adoption entry points, lifelong starts and custom roles retained. Stolen Vitality sacrifice eligibility, terminal-life exclusion, failure and history/event text adapted from ClanGen 904012b9e9c62ab24a8988ae23d8a516232ff7e2 scripts/events_module/consequences.py and resources/lang/en/cruel_season/special_text.en.json (MPL-2.0), preserving local death-history and murder identity contracts.
Upstream projects.ClanGen artists and contributors: Mode-button artwork, card category icons, colony-header buttons, moon phases, seasonal vines and selection-box artwork from LifeGen development bab3814eee64852125c004dac588fab809a730e9 (https://github.com/sedgestripe/clangen/tree/bab3814eee64852125c004dac588fab809a730e9/resources/images); Cruel Season card artwork and deck backdrops, unchanged source assets from ClanGen development 904012b9e9c62ab24a8988ae23d8a516232ff7e2.
